english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sewing or knitting stitch, and it is also used when counting surgical stitches, as in 縫幾針.

exampleSentences.english: The nurse says they can remove one stitch from my back tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 姑娘話聽日可以拆我背脊嗰一針喇。
